title: NVIDIA offers free API keys for 80+ top AI models worldwide #NVIDIA #FreeAPI #aidevelopment
description: NVIDIA offers free API access to over 80 top AI models, including GLM, Kimi, Minimax, DeepSeek, and OpenAI. Users can instantly generate API keys to integrate these models with platforms like Claude Code and Cursor without any cost. This move eliminates the need to pay for API credits, providing developers and businesses with a significant cost-saving opportunity while accessing powerful AI tools. The streamlined setup enables faster experimentation and deployment of AI-powered applications across various industries. By centralizing leading AI models in one accessible platform, NVIDIA accelerates innovation and broadens AI adoption, benefiting creators and companies aiming to leverage advanced machine learning technologies. #NVIDIA #AIAPI #OpenAI #GLM #Minimax #DeepSeek #ClaudeCode #Cursor #AImodels #FreeAPI #AItools #MachineLearning #APIAccess #AIintegration #TechInnovation
